newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lorenzo says 1996 net target attainable.
newsitem.headline: Lorenzo says 1996 net target attainable.

text.p: Philippine container shipowner Lorenzo Shipping Corp (LSC) said on Wednesday it was confident it could reach its net income target of 159 million pesos for this year.
The company posted a net income of 100.47 million pesos in the first nine months of the year.
Lorenzo, which was listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange in July this year, reported a net income of 37 million pesos in 1995.

"In view of our improved income performance, as seen by the 277 percent surge in income for the first three quarters ... and the contribution of other favourable factors, LSC can attain its target net income," president Ramon Garcia said in a statement.
Garcia added that the second half of the year is usually more profitable as cargo volumes increased.
He said an additional port of call in southern Philippines and the full utilisation of its ships should further raise the company's revenues.
The company is projecting a net income of 186 million pesos in 1997. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
